explanation: A mountainous region on the Sinai Peninsula where God gave Moses the Ten Commandments.
The prophet and leader of the Israelites who led them out of slavery in Egypt and received the Ten Commandments from God.
The Hebrew people, descendants of Jacob, who were freed from slavery in Egypt under the leadership of Moses.
A sacred and binding agreement between God and humans, often involving promises and conditions.
The specific day when God would come down on Mount Sinai and speak to Moses and the Israelites.
Dedicated or set apart for God; something that is spiritually pure and worthy.
A limit or barrier that separates the holy area around Mount Sinai from the common or profane.
